verdict.rationale: Luma documents reusable creative workflows (Luma Skills, 'Build a Creative Workflow Once, Run It Forever') and multi-step Luma Agents. However, nothing in the evidence describes a recurring schedule, such as cron-style triggers, timed runs, or automatic re-execution. A reusable workflow you run on demand is an adjacent capability, not scheduling, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
